# `aitbc contract deploy`

Deploy a named smart contract to the blockchain.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc contract deploy [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--contract-name` | text | — | yes | Contract name |
| `--rpc-url` | text | `http://localhost:8202` | no | Blockchain RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc contract deploy --contract-name <contract_name>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc contract deploy --contract-name <contract_name> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
